jobs.title: Automation Engineering Internship | Great opportunity for Fresh graduates
jobs.description: Employer career level: Recent College Graduate. Job Title: Automation Engineering - Full Time internship Location: Cairo, Egypt About Us At Siemens, we strongly believe in the value of a digital portfolio. That's why Smart Infrastructure combines Digital Power Distribution and Digital Building Infrastructure technologies — enabling our customers to enjoy intuitive buildings that are comfortable, safe, secure, and energy efficient. Siemens Smart Infrastructure intelligently connects energy systems, buildings, and industries to adapt and evolve the way we live and work. Together with our customers and partners, we build an ecosystem that intuitively responds to the needs of people and helps make better use of resources — enabling our customers to thrive, communities to progress, and sustainable development to advance. Your Role – International, Challenging and Future-Oriented The Intern Automation Engineer supports the engineering, testing, commissioning, and maintenance activities associated with Substaion Automation Systems (SAS), SCADA, RTU, and communication networks. This role offers hands-on exposure to digital substations, smart grid technologies, protection systems, and industrial communication protocols while developing technical and professional competencies under the supervision of experienced engineers. Key Responsibilities Assist in the engineering and implementation of Substation Automation and Control Systems. Support configuration and testing activities for RTUs, SCADA/HMI systems, and communication networks. Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). Participate in commissioning activities for substation automation projects Gain practical exposure to Siemens automation platforms including SICAM A8000, SICAM PAS, and SIPROTEC relays. Learn and apply communication protocols including IEC 61850, IEC 101/104, and Modbus. Support configuration activities using engineering tools such as DIGSI, SICAM Device Manager, and SICAM Toolbox. Assist in preparing technical reports, engineering documentation, and project records. Work collaboratively with project managers, engineers, technicians, and customer representatives. Your Qualifications and Skills – Digital and Solid! Candidates should be recently completed a bachelor’s degree in one of the following disciplines: -Electrical Engineering -Electronics & Communications Engineering -Automation & Control Engineering Previous internships, academic projects, laboratory work, or graduation projects related to automation, protection, SCADA, power systems, or networking will be considered an advantage. Basic understanding of electrical power systems and substations. Fundamental knowledge of automation and control systems. Awareness of SCADA and RTU concepts. Basic networking knowledge and communication principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong teamwork and collaboration abilities. What else do you need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced engineering technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Internship | Build the Workforce of Tomorrow
jobs.description: Employer career level: Recent College Graduate. Job Title: Talent Acquisition Internship | Build the Workforce of Tomorrow Location: Cairo, Egypt About Us At Siemens, we believe the best teams are built on different perspectives, lived experiences, and bold ideas. This internship is designed with you in mind—offering real work, real mentorship, and a real seat at the table inside one of the world's leading technology companies. Introduction An internship at Siemens is an exceptional learning opportunity for senior students and fresh graduates looking to dive deep into modern Talent Acquisition practices, work within a truly international team setup, and grow their knowledge and skills to the next level. Now, we are recruiting for a passionate, forward-thinking Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team in Cairo and help us shape the future of work. What You'll Do Support Recruitment: You will help post roles, screen candidates, and coordinate interviews alongside our experienced Talent Acquisition Partners. Engage Candidates: As part of your daily job, you will communicate with applicants professionally, ensuring a smooth, welcoming, and great candidate experience for everyone. Research & Source Talent: Together with our team, you will explore modern sourcing strategies with a strong focus on building diverse and inclusive talent pools. Contribute to D&I Projects: With us you will get hands-on with real-world initiatives around accessibility, inclusion, and employer branding across the region. Learn and Grow: As our Intern, you will be attending dedicated training sessions, shadow seasoned HR professionals, and build versatile skills you will carry throughout your career. What You Bring Recent graduate or senior student with an HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or related background. Genuine curiosity about Talent Acquisition and the future of HR. Basic understanding of data analytics and big data concepts, with initial experience in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Excel) considered a strong advantage. Strong Arabic & English communication skills (written and verbal). A proactive, can-do attitude with an eagerness to learn. A genuine passion for inclusion, diversity, and people-centric workplaces. What We Offer Dedicated guidance and coaching from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals. Hands-on ownership of meaningful D&I and talent acquisition initiatives. Working inside a Fortune 500 global technology powerhouse with an international team. You Need to Know Siemens is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on any grounds and are committed to building teams that reflect the full diversity of the world we serve. We warmly welcome applications from People of Determination and individuals with disabilities . Reasonable accommodation is available at every stage — from application through to your last day as an intern. Just let us know what you need. Ready to make your mark? Apply now and help us build a world where everyone belongs.

jobs.title: Government Affairs Internship Opportunities
jobs.description: Collaborate with the CELA Africa Government Affairs Leads to provide general policy and government affairs support, utilizing consultants as needed. Conduct research across legal, policy and technology sectors, preparing comparative analyses, translations, checklists and summaries to support team strategies. Participate in data collection and intelligence gathering to help craft position papers, policy briefings and legislative testimony. Support the management of internal stakeholders and external relationships with coalitions, the public sector and relevant interest groups to advance public sector objectives and achieve regulatory and legislative outcomes. Organize and support internal and external events and communications, including content development, material drafting, social media engagement, strategic positioning and campaigning activities. Undertake any other tasks assigned by the Government Affairs Director for Africa and/or the Government Affairs Leads. Degree in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, International Relations or a similar field. Legal authorization to work in Egypt. Fluency in French, Arabic and English (all three required). Excellent knowledge of technology and emerging policy issues around AI, cloud computing and data governance. Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder and relationship management skills. Strong teamwork, collaboration and project management skills. Ability to analyse, conceptualize and visualize information and data, and to identify and solve complex problems creatively. Highly motivated and proactive, with a growth mindset, the ability to learn quickly and use good judgment, and the cross-cultural skills to adapt to different work and communication styles. At least 1 year of prior experience in a related field (government relations, regulatory affairs, public policy, law or technology). Demonstrated ability to develop and manage strategic relationships to influence public and technology policy, and to review, draft or contribute to policy documents, briefing notes, whitepapers and advocacy materials. Demonstrated understanding of Africa's public sector dynamics or regional governance institutions (e.g. African Union, ECOWAS, EAC, SADC).

jobs.title: Software Engineer, POWER
jobs.description: Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. Key Responsibilities: Problem Solving: Utilize AI-assisted and traditional debugging techniques to analyze complex hardware/software issues and drive them to resolution. Embedded SW Development: Develop & Test robust, safety-critical Embedded C code for various microcontrollers: In Basic Software (BSW), Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL),  low-level drivers (ADC, PWM, SPI, CAN, LIN), and Product specific Application SW. Powertrain Application: Implement software for high-voltage and electromechanical products—including Inverters, DC-DC Converters, Battery Management Systems (BMS), Thermal Management, and Smart Actuators —translating control laws and physical constraints into efficient code. AI & Innovation: Actively leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI tools to accelerate development, and optimize workflows, while applying LLM fundamentals to automate routine engineering tasks. Standard Compliance: Execute all development activities in strict adherence to automotive standards, including AUTOSAR architecture, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) , and ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity) . System-Level Contribution: Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and thermal engineers to define system constraints and ensure software optimizes the physics of the powertrain (e.g., cooling strategies, motor torque limits). Quality & KPIs: Maintain high standards for code quality (MISRA C compliance), documentation, and testing, ensuring all personal and team Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are met or exceeded. Agile Collaboration: Work effectively within an Agile/Scrum framework, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews to deliver incremental value. Cross-Functional Teamwork: Engage smoothly with cross-functional teams—including Requirements, System Engineering, and Testing/Validation—to ensure seamless integration and traceability from customer requirements to final product. Reporting: Provide clear, regular status reports to management regarding development progress, risks, and technical challenges. Candidate Profile : Education: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 0–2 years of experience in embedded software development (internships and academic projects count). AI : Excellent Generative AI adoption, Agentic AI experience, and LLM fundamentals. Machine Learning is a plus Electrical Systems: Understanding of Power Electronics (Inverters, DC-DC converters) and Electric Motors . Knowledge of Control Theory: Automatic Control, Control Laws and modeling (Simulink/MATLAB). Mechanical Systems: Basic understanding of Mechanics, Electromechanics, and Thermodynamics (heat transfer/cooling systems) is a strong advantage. Programming: Strong proficiency in any programming language. Microcontrollers (is a plus) : Deep understanding of microcontroller architecture (memory map, registers, interrupts, timers). Embedded Fundamentals (is a plus) : Knowledge of RTOS concepts, Low-level Software, and Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL). Automotive Standards (is a plus) : Familiarity with AUTOSAR architecture and methodology) and Functional Safety ISO26262 is a plus. High problem solving skills, and debugging. jobs.title: 2027 WHS Intern
jobs.description: Job Summary Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally. Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date. Key job responsibilities - Familiarize and help with the organization and processes for new launches - Assist the Safety New Build Manager and the Safety Engineer in delivering safety excellent processes and operations - Support safety process systems through participation in planned inspections of buildings, machines and jobs for accident prevention - Perform and update Risk Assessments and Job Hazard Analyses - Analyse accident data and develop standards to ensure prevention of accidents - Supporting investigations linked to accidents and prepare accident reports to identify preventive safety measures for incorporation into the safety program - Help to develop safety procedures and implement training programs to meet the needs of managers and associates in regards to critical safety issues - Potential relocation to the designated work location Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027.
